milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate toward the blue concrete wall and be looking at it. Target is the center of the wall at spawn-relative (8, 2, 4). max_distance=8 ensures the player has moved meaningfully from spawn toward the wall, and facing_tolerance=60 confirms they are looking at it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate behind the blue concrete wall to find the hopper. Target is the hopper at spawn-relative (8, 0, 6). max_distance=5 requires the player to have navigated around/past the wall (which spans Z=3-5), and facing_tolerance=60 confirms they are looking at the hopper.

Uses inventory_has because mining polished diorite stairs with a pickaxe causes the block to drop as an item into the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 polished_diorite_stairs and a wooden pickaxe (sufficient for stone-type blocks), so having ≥1 in inventory confirms successful mining.
